sources.title: dmMaze/comic-text-detector: Manga&Comic text detection - GitHub
sources.snippet: We used text detection model of manga-image-translator to generate text lines annotations for manga, and Manga-Text-Segmentation with some post-processing to generate masks for both manga and comics.

sources.title: Text Detection | mayocream/koharu | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Koharu utilizes multiple specialized models for this task: comic-text-detector: A multi-stage model for bounding boxes and segmentation. comic-text-bubble-detector: Based on RT-DETR, specialized for distinguishing between text and speech bubble containers. manga-text-segmentation-2025: A high-resolution segmentation model for precise text masks.
